Hostiles Are Too Easy
Source: https://github.com/MinecraftIsTooEasy/HostilesAreTooEasy
License: CC0 1.0 Universal

The upstream project dedicates the work to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal.
Survival Ascension adapts its boss-driven dynamic-difficulty progression concept for a modern
Minecraft 26.2 world-stage system. No upstream assets, mixins, namespaces, or legacy Minecraft
runtime code are bundled.
